alt: A wide fan of printed presentation slides arranged in a wave on a blue dotted surface, with a large red PowerPoint logo on the right.
caption: A fan of paper slides with Microsoft PowerPoint logos on a dotted blue surface
description: A large fan of colorful presentation slides creates a wave shape across a light blue dotted background. Each individual slide features different chart and layout designs alongside small PowerPoint icons. A larger, square red PowerPoint logo sits separately on the right side of the display.
